fields.name: Śrī Gaṅgāmātā Gosvāminī
fields.aka: Gaṅgāmātā Goswamini, Gaṅgāmātā Govamini, Gaṅgā Mātā, Gaṅgāmātā Ṭhākurāṇī, Śacī (birth name)
fields.place: Puṭiyā (Rajshahi), daughter of King Nareśa Nārāyaṇa; Vṛndāvana and Rādhā-kuṇḍa; Purī — Sārvabhauma's house by the Śveta-gaṅgā (Gaṅgāmātā Maṭha)
fields.guru: Haridāsa Paṇḍita (the Abhidhāna: an «anuśiṣya», a later disciple in Gadādhara Paṇḍita's line; the record: Haridāsa Paṇḍita of Govindadeva)
fields.disciples: King Mukunda Deva of Purī and the paḍichās; Mahīdhara Śarmā; many pūjārīs
fields.notes:
Śacī, only daughter of King Nareśa Nārāyaṇa of Puṭiyā; refused marriage, left her kingdom, received the eighteen-syllable mantra from Haridāsa Paṇḍita in Vṛndāvana after severe renunciation; with Lakṣmīpriyā did bhajana at Rādhā-kuṇḍa; by her guru's order lived in Purī in Sārvabhauma's house, revived the service of his Dāmodara śālagrāma and spoke the Bhāgavatam. The Gaṅgā carried her into Jagannātha's temple on Vāruṇī day; jailed as a thief, freed at Jagannātha's order, she initiated King Mukunda Deva and the paḍichās, and was called Gaṅgāmātā (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

Her guru: the Abhidhāna says «Śrī Haridāsa Paṇḍita, an anuśiṣya of … Gosvāmī» — a later Haridāsa Paṇḍita of the same line; the texts of the record take him as the disciple of Ananta Ācārya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 8). In the tree she is under Haridāsa Paṇḍita with the line marked «disputed».

fields.name: Siddha Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa Bābājī (Kāmyavana)
fields.aka: Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa Bābājī, Jāya Kṛṣṇa dāsa bābājī, Siddha Bābā of Kāmyavana
fields.guru: Of Gaṅgāmātā Gosvāminī's line (by paramparā); dīkṣā in the mantra of Lord Caitanya
fields.notes: Siddha of Kāmyavana who first introduced the present tradition of rāgānugā bhajana in Vraja; by paramparā of Gaṅgāmātā Gosvāminī's line. Received the service of Rādhā-Madanamohana from Navakiśora Gosvāmī. Friend of Mahānta Bhagavān dāsa of Rāmadiyā; Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa of Govardhana and Siddha Madhusūdana dāsa of Sūrya-kuṇḍa were loyal to him; he taught Kṛṣṇadāsa renunciation («green wood will not catch fire»).

fields.name: Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī (Govardhana)
fields.aka: Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī Mahārāj (Of Govardhana), Kṛṣṇa dāsa bābājī (Govardhan), Siddha Bābā, Baṭakṛṣṇa (birth name)
fields.disciples: Balarāma dāsa Bābājī, Nityānanda dāsa Bābājī, Bhagavān dāsa Bābājī of Kālnā
fields.notes: Born Baṭakṛṣṇa, youngest son of Sanātana Kānungo and Jārī of Orissa; his mother became satī and told him to live as a Vaiṣṇava in Vṛndāvana. At sixteen he walked to Vraja; learnt bhajana from Vaiṣṇava Caraṇa dāsa of Brahma-kuṇḍa, compiler of the Padakalpataru, in Narottama's line. Guarded Govindajī's doors in Jaipur for eight to ten years; troubled by passion, he went to Siddha Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa of Kāmyavana, who taught him renunciation; then lived at Govardhana.

fields.name: Siddha Balarāma dāsa Bābājī (Jhāḍu-maṇḍala)
fields.aka: Balarāma Dās Bābājī Mahārāja, Balarāma dāsa bābājī, Balarāma Dās Bābājī Mahāśaya
fields.guru: Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī of Govardhana (dīkṣā at forty)
fields.notes: Took dīkṣā at forty from Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī, mastered Sanskrit and copied the Bhāgavatam for his guru; read the Bhāgavatam daily on the Yamunā to the Vaiṣṇavas; very strict with women and caste-pride (the record). Not Balarāma dāsa Bābājī, the Oriya Mahānta of Pisimā's Gaura-Nitāi (her guru).

fields.name: Siddha Bhagavān dāsa Bābājī (Kālnā)
fields.aka: Bhagavān Dās Bābājī Mahārāja (Kalana), Bhagavān dāsa Bābā of Kālnā
fields.notes: Disciple of Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī of Govardhana; from Orissa but spoke only Bengali; set up the worship of Nāma-brahma at Kālnā; reserved about rāgānugā bhajana (the record).

fields.name: Pisimā Gosvāminī (Candraśaśī Devī)
fields.aka: Pisima Mātā, Pisima Gosvamini, Candraśaśī Devī
fields.guru: Mahānta Balarāma dāsa Bābājī of Orissa (Viṣṇu-dīkṣā), servant of the Gaura-Nitāi found in Birbhum
fields.notes:
Candraśaśī Devī of the Mukhopādhyāya family of Ulāgrām, Nadia; served the Gaura-Nitāi found under a bush in Birbhum c. 1770, who called her «mother» and tore her sāri to keep her; with Mahānta Balarāma dāsa took them to Vṛndāvana (Banakhaṇḍī); called Pisimā like her friend Bhakta (the record, after Haridāsa Gosvāmī).

Her guru Balarāma dāsa, an Oriya mahānta of c. 1770, is not Balarāma dāsa Bābājī of Jhāḍu-maṇḍala (19th century), under whom she was in the tree: he has his own record now (06-11-2026).

An Oriya saint who, on pilgrimage c. 1770, came to Siuri where the Gaura-Nitāi deities found in a bush in Birbhum were worshipped, and was told in a dream to serve them; gave Viṣṇu-dīkṣā to Candraśaśī Devī (Pisimā) and with her took the deities to Vṛndāvana (the record of Pisimā, after Haridāsa Gosvāmī's Nitāi-Gaura Vigraha-līlā Kāhinī). His own guru is not known. Not Balarāma dāsa Bābājī of Jhāḍu-maṇḍala, disciple of Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa of Govardhana (19th century).

fields.name: Siddha Nityānanda dāsa Bābājī (Madana-mohana Ṭhaurā)
fields.aka: Nityānanda Dāsa Bābājī, Nityānanda Dāsa Baba
fields.disappearance: Kārtika pūrṇimā (Rāsa-pūrṇimā), by the Mānasa-gaṅgā, before the Niyama-sevā
fields.guru: Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī of Govardhana (his second disciple)
fields.disciples: Rāmakṛṣṇa dāsa Paṇḍita Bābājī; Kṛṣṇaprasāda dāsa (veśa); Gaura dāsa; Narottama dāsa Adhikārī; Gaurakiśora dāsa; Nṛsiṁhānanda Bhaṭṭa; Jagadānanda dāsa of Orissa (veśa)
fields.notes:
Of Gadādhara Paṇḍita's family, a Rāḍhī brāhmaṇa; the second disciple of Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī of Govardhana, calling Balarāma dāsa Bābājī his elder brother (the record). Knew the Govinda-līlāmṛta by heart; chanted a lakh of names a day in silence; passed away on Rāsa-pūrṇimā by the Mānasa-gaṅgā.

He was in the branch «Other Vaiṣṇava lines» (guru not known): his record says he was Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa's disciple, so he is now under him (06-11-2026).

fields.guru: An unknown mahānta of Gaṅgāmātā's line (mantra by the Yamunā); Śrī Rādhā herself (the record)
fields.notes:
Siddha of Sūrya-kuṇḍa, who gave the bābājī veśa to Jagannātha dāsa Bābājī. A kulīna boy who fled on his wedding night to Vṛndāvana and received a mantra by the Yamunā from an unknown mahānta of Gaṅgāmātā's line; Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa of Govardhana and Siddha Jayakṛṣṇa of Kāmyavana would not teach him without knowing his guru; at Rādhā-kuṇḍa Śrī Rādhā saved him, told him to live at Sūrya-kuṇḍa and never to give that mantra. Healed by Rādhā in the form of a Vraja girl; became known as «Siddha». Taught many but gave no dīkṣā. Jagannātha dāsa Bābājī's record places him in the line of Baladeva Vidyābhūṣaṇa through Uddhava dāsa.

In the tree under Gaṅgāmātā (his mantra came from her line; the line is marked «disputed»), no longer in «Other Vaiṣṇava lines» (06-11-2026).

fields.name: Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa Deva («Rājen Bābu»)
fields.aka: Radharamanacarana Dāsa Deva, Rājen Bābu, Baḍa Bābājī
fields.place: Mahiṣkholā; Ghoḍākhālī; Ayodhyā (his guru); Navadvīpa; Purī
fields.guru: A guru met by the Sarayū at Ayodhyā (name not given in the record); earlier Yogendranātha Bhaṭṭācārya of Mulghar
fields.notes: Son of Mohanacandra Ghoṣ and Kanakasundarī; married three times; his only son died at six. Left his estate work in tears for the tenants; told by Kālī at Bhavānīpur that his guru awaited him by the Sarayū, he went there and received the mantra; in Navadvīpa, called Rājen Bābu, he led kīrtana with Navadvīpa dāsa and others and composed songs in ecstasy (the record). In «Other Vaiṣṇava lines» because his guru's name is not known.

fields.name: Siddha Gauracaraṇa dāsa Bābājī (Dāujī)
fields.aka: Gauracharana dāsa bābājī, Siddha Gauracarana Dāsa Bābājī (Dauji, Kunjara)
fields.place: Talakhāḍi (Jessore); Navadvīpa; the cave at Dāujī, Mahāvana (Vraja)
fields.guru: Siddha Caitanya dāsa Bābājī of Navadvīpa (some say Bhagavān dāsa Bābājī of Kālnā)
fields.notes: Of a family claiming descent from Lokanātha Gosvāmī's; took shelter of Siddha Caitanya dāsa Bābājī of Navadvīpa (some say Bhagavān dāsa of Kālnā); did bhajana twenty years in a cave at Dāujī in the mood of sakhya; later chanted only the names of Gaura and His associates; gave dīkṣā and veśa to Dayāla dāsa (the record). Siddha Caitanya dāsa has no record yet: in «Other Vaiṣṇava lines».

fields.name: Siddha Rāmakṛṣṇa dāsa Paṇḍita Bābājī
fields.aka: Rāmakṛṣṇa dāsa bābājī, Rāmakṛṣṇa Dāsa, Rāmapratāpa Miśra (birth name)
fields.guru: Siddha Nityānanda dāsa Bābājī (dīkṣā and veśa); instructed also by Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī
fields.notes: Born Rāmapratāpa Miśra of a Gauḍa brāhmaṇa family of Jaipur; reached Vṛndāvana at thirteen and studied nyāya, the Ṣaṭ-sandarbha, the Bhāgavatam and the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa; at twenty took dīkṣā and veśa from Nityānanda dāsa Bābājī; learnt the whole Govinda-līlāmṛta; saw Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa at Varṣāṇā after chanting the Gopāla mantra for seventeen days (the record).

fields.name: Kṛṣṇaprasāda dāsa Bābājī («Guḍhiḍi Bābā»)
fields.aka: Kṛṣṇaprasāda Dāsa Bābājī, Kṛṣṇa Prasāda dāsa bābājī, Guḍhiḍi Bābā
fields.notes: Veśa-disciple of Siddha Nityānanda dāsa Bābājī, who sent him to serve Gallujī Mahārāja, a priest of Rādhā-ramaṇa: he served the whole family for twenty years; called Guḍhiḍi Bābā for the torn quilt he dragged to wipe out his footprints (the record).
